name: endoflife
description: endoflife.date is a public catalog of end-of-life dates and support lifecycles for software products. This CLI wraps its public JSON API v1 and Atom feeds to list products, categories, tags and identifiers, and to look up release cycles and EOL dates.

commands.name: list-products
commands.summary: List all tracked products (slug, label, category, tags, aliases)

commands.name: export-products-full
commands.summary: Dump all products with full details including every release cycle (large response)

commands.name: get-product
commands.summary: Get a product's metadata: label, category, tags, aliases, identifiers, version command, links

params.name: product
params.description: Product slug as returned by list-products 'name', e.g. python, nodejs, alpine-linux

commands.name: list-releases
commands.summary: List all release cycles of a product with release, LTS, end-of-active-support and EOL dates

commands.name: get-latest-release
commands.summary: Get the latest release cycle of a product with its support and EOL dates

commands.name: get-release
commands.summary: Get one release cycle of a product (e.g. python 3.12) with its support and EOL status and dates

params.name: release
params.description: Release cycle name as in list-releases 'name', e.g. 3.12 for python or 22 for nodejs

commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List product categories (e.g. framework, server-app, database, lang, os, service)

params.name: category
params.description: Category name from list-categories, e.g. database, lang, os, framework, server-app, service

commands.name: list-tags
commands.summary: List all product tags (e.g. amazon, linux-distribution, java-distribution)

commands.name: list-products-by-tag
commands.summary: List products that have a given tag

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag name from list-tags, e.g. amazon, database, linux-distribution

commands.name: list-identifier-types
commands.summary: List supported product identifier types (purl, cpe, ...)

commands.name: list-identifiers
commands.summary: List all identifiers of a given type (e.g. CPE or purl strings) mapped to product slugs; use it to resolve a CPE/purl to a product

params.name: type
params.description: Identifier type from list-identifier-types, e.g. cpe or purl

commands.name: list-new-products
commands.summary: Recently added products, newest first (Atom feed)

commands.name: list-product-events
commands.summary: Timeline of a product's release and end-of-life events (Atom feed)

notes: The site is public and read-only. No login is needed and no command changes data.

Product slugs are the 'name' field from list-products (e.g. python, nodejs, alpine-linux). Aliases such as 'alma' or 'adonis' are listed there but may not resolve as API paths, so use the canonical name.

Dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings. Fields such as eolFrom, eoasFrom and ltsFrom can be null when a date is unknown or does not apply. isEol, isEoas and isMaintained are computed as of the API's generated_at time.
eoas means end of active support and eoes means end of extended support. The product 'labels' object (shown by get-product) gives the product-specific names for these phases.
Release cycle names are product-specific strings, e.g. '3.12' for python or '22' for nodejs. Use list-releases to find valid values for get-release.

The API has no server-side search or pagination. To find a product by name, filter the output of list-products by name, label or aliases. export-products-full returns every product with every release, so the response is large.
Site search runs in the browser over the static index /assets/js/search-data.json, which has no query support. It is not exposed as a command.
Each product has an iCalendar file at /calendar/{product}.ics. It was observed only as a file download, not as a recorded request, so no command covers it.
